scope.basis: B49 canonical_source_paths plus exactly8 B50 core/example RTL sources
scope.excluded: Testbenches, reports, work/.work, followup archives and all non-formal source copies
scope.observation: Native raw file reads, SHA256 and lexical extraction; final source hash/size/mtime recheck, not an atomic cross-file snapshot
scope.lexical_method: Mask line/block comments and double-quoted strings, preserve escaped identifiers; case-sensitive module/macromodule declaration extraction with optional automatic/static lifetime
scope.limitations: No preprocessor evaluation, HDL parser/AST, elaboration, port/hierarchy validation, compilation, simulation, synthesis, PnR, STA, board or PPA
scope.filelist_closure_method: Resolve each literal source entry from the recorded cwd; require a current source pin and declared top; check per-closure module-name uniqueness; do not elaborate module instantiations.

canonical_pin_listing_format: UTF8 without BOM; ordinal path order; each line path TAB lower_hex_sha256 LF
